EBS-CON-MER-UNT-001.notes:
Book-based delegated decision: Retain the compact worker frame, paired working arms and visible cargo. The drill/gripper and repaired ceramic shoulder match the story. Simplify the decorative mast panel and make loaded/unloaded cargo readable during later production; this remains a worker, not an armed robot.

Evidence: attached novel paragraphs 143, 1536, 1607. See book-based-review.json for exact source hash and retained excerpts. This is a visual-direction choice, not canon or production acceptance.

EBS-CON-KHA-UNT-001.notes:
Book-based delegated decision: Replace the spider-like machine with hose manipulators. The story shows an ordinary cultivator using a staff, carrying a sling, and working with broad forearms; expanded game canon identifies a stocky humanoid Kharuun. Design living strata, amber wrist nodules, staff and carried Matter. Avoid turning an ordinary person into a generic insect worker.

Rework the smooth cream shell, conspicuous purple crystals and manufactured-looking cannon into grown charcoal strata, amber seams and a shoulder shard-caster whose attachment can split with damage. Do not infer exact limb count from the prose.

EBS-CON-FWL-SYS-001.notes:
Book-based delegated decision: Retain courtyard-scale bowl and central spire as the family base. Rework the ceremonial stone machinery into vitrified charcoal glass with quiet fracture seams and doubled outline/shadows. Lower the gold glow and floating spectacle so Dormant reads as held potential. Existing rings are a design proposal, not textually established engineering.

EBS-CON-FWL-SYS-002.notes:
Book-based delegated decision: Retain the collapse direction, but make this a transition reference rather than an enduring geyser state: telegraph climbs the spire, then spire folds into bowl, light cuts off and a dark cracked spent site remains. Book/Bible amber conflicts with REL-ART-014 cyan geyser; color reconciliation remains open and no requirement is changed.

Evidence: attached novel paragraphs 244, 245, 246, 247. See book-based-review.json for exact source hash and retained excerpts. This is a visual-direction choice, not canon or production acceptance.

EBS-CON-FWL-SYS-003.notes:
Book-based delegated decision: Retain intact core and custody ring. Reduce the spraying fragments and active energy column: the novel says the spire steadies into one outline and a slow ring holds around the bowl. Show ongoing custody and continued cost through restrained motion, not a more powerful Harvest.

Evidence: attached novel paragraphs 2510, 2511. See book-based-review.json for exact source hash and retained excerpts. This is a visual-direction choice, not canon or production acceptance.

EBS-CON-FWL-SYS-004.notes:
Book-based delegated decision: Retain magenta transformation identity and the shared bowl/spire. Make the effect point to an actual temporary crossing or other authorized terrain feature, with readable duration and expiry. Orbiting rings alone do not communicate Reshape’s spatial consequence. The prose supports temporary manifested ground, not this exact machine. Chapter 24 explicitly says this novel’s basin has no realized Reshape precedent; the new state design therefore requires the game’s authored reference, not a claimed book scene.

Evidence: attached novel paragraphs 198, 2499, 3630, 3328. See book-based-review.json for exact source hash and retained excerpts. This is a visual-direction choice, not canon or production acceptance.

EBS-CON-FWL-SYS-005.notes:
Book-based delegated decision: Replace the giant luminous tornado as the Future Well production reference. It obscures the bowl/core, turns sustained custody into spectacle and fails to explain permanent exhaustion or temporary terrain. Preserve the image in visual history; it must not define the state family.

Evidence: attached novel paragraphs 191, 246, 247, 2511. See book-based-review.json for exact source hash and retained excerpts. This is a visual-direction choice, not canon or production acceptance.

EBS-CON-FWL-SYS-007.notes:
Book-based delegated decision: Retain the central landmark’s relationship to the route and opposing forces as composition reference. Rework the polished gold plinth and floating collectible appearance into a vitrified bowl with embedded core identity. This choice applies to the Well region only; it does not approve the surrounding skiff, units, sky or map geometry.

Evidence: attached novel paragraphs 191, 196. See book-based-review.json for exact source hash and retained excerpts. This is a visual-direction choice, not canon or production acceptance.

family_notes: Book-based delegated direction: Rework one bowl-and-core-spire family. Dormant: quiet fractured glass and doubled outline. Harvest: visible commitment followed by irreversible collapse and a dark spent site. Preserve: stabilized core and slow custody ring. Reshape: temporary authored terrain with expiry cues. Reject the giant tornado as the family definition. Resolve the amber-versus-cyan Harvest conflict before production; no game rule or canon status changes.
